purpose: Frozen adjudication of what drives the previously observed AP > AMP reliability: multiplicative amplitude scaffold versus phase-specific interference

frozen_signal_pipeline.partitions: all 15 unique disjoint 2-vs-2 run partitions; unused fifth run ignored

primary_tests.phase_specific_reproducibility: INTERFERENCE cross-run reliability > 0 in each cohort by one-sided subject-level sign-flip p < 0.025
primary_tests.phase_contribution_to_full: cross-half INTERFERENCE-to-FULL congruence > 0 in each cohort by one-sided subject-level sign-flip p < 0.025
primary_tests.product_scaffold_reproducibility: PRODUCT cross-run reliability > 0 in each cohort by one-sided subject-level sign-flip p < 0.025

decision_logic.MIXED_PHASE_AND_PRODUCT: INTERFERENCE reliability and INTERFERENCE-to-FULL congruence pass in both cohorts, and PRODUCT reliability passes in both cohorts
decision_logic.PHASE_SPECIFIC_WITHOUT_PRODUCT_DOMINANCE: INTERFERENCE reliability and INTERFERENCE-to-FULL congruence pass in both cohorts, PRODUCT fails in at least one cohort
decision_logic.PRODUCT_SCAFFOLD_DOMINANT: PRODUCT reliability passes in both cohorts, while phase-specific criterion fails

interpretation_guardrail: PAPER02 is a prospectively frozen component analysis motivated by the prior phase-shuffle result, but it reuses previously analyzed CA and CB cohorts. It is an adjudication/falsification analysis, not a new independent neural cohort confirmation and not evidence of consciousness specificity or causality.
